official_sources.name: EA LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Tiles

direct_official_checks: time-stamped DTM archive contains surveys since 1998
data are GeoTIFF rasters in 5km zipfiles
heights are presented in metres referenced to Ordnance Survey Newlyn
data are aligned to the OS Grid
transformation depends on survey time period
metadata index records survey dates resolution transformation and geoidal model
quality_effect: Makes survey epoch and transform/geoid provenance mandatory before numeric elevation acceptance.
